All objectives complete. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket titled `c2rd3 RD Bench Ticket` created (ref **RD-1015**), confirmed present in the list and detail view.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `c2rd3 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. Computed price: **$125.00** ($100 × 1.25). Row: `c2rd3 RD Part A | $100.00 | 25% | 1 | Bench Supplies Co. | $125.00`.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `c2rd3 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. Computed price: **$250.00** ($200 × 1.25). Row: `c2rd3 RD Part B | $200.00 | 25% | 1 | Acme Distributors | $250.00`. Ticket total at that point: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup kept at 25%). New computed price: **$187.50** ($150 × 1.25). Row: `c2rd3 RD Part A | $150.00 | 25% | 1 | Bench Supplies Co. | $187.50`. Ticket total updated to $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket status set to **Ready** (status badge reads "Ready"; action buttons changed to Mark Draft / Mark Closed / Archive ticket). The enforced precondition, discovered by attempting "Mark Ready" on a separate part-less probe ticket (RD-1016), was: **"Ticket is not ready — A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready."** The main ticket satisfied this because it already had two parts, so the Draft → Ready transition was accepted immediately. No other preconditions (no required fields, no intermediate statuses, no confirmation) were demanded.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted (each via a Delete button plus a "Confirm" / "Delete part" confirmation dialog); the parts table then showed "No parts on this ticket yet." The ticket was archived via the "Archive ticket" button — it now carries an **Archived** badge (title displayed as "c2rd3 RD Bench Ticket Archived" in the list, status still Ready, 0 parts). Verified in the ticket list: with "Show archived" unchecked, neither RD-1015 nor the probe ticket appears (11 tickets, RD-1001–RD-1014); with it checked, both appear as archived. The throwaway probe ticket RD-1016 was also archived, so nothing created by this run remains active.
